_meta.notes: Mid-cap S-REITs. All figures re-sourced to primary SGXNet / issuer-IR PDFs via pipeline/extract_pdf.cjs. Property yields computed from disclosed NPI / total assets or portfolio fair value where the manager does not explicitly disclose a portfolio NPI yield (managers seldom do — only individual property cap rates are normally published). Gearing-incl-perps recomputed using each manager's disclosed perpetual securities balance plus PFA borrowings, divided by the same Deposited Property denominator implied by the disclosed gearing ratio. ESR-REIT NAV S$2.52 reflects post 10-for-1 unit consolidation. FCT DPU TTM = 1H FY26 (6.136) + 2H FY25 (6.059). Lendlease primary IR document is the quarterly factsheet (Q3 FY26); the full results press release is hosted only on globenewswire (non-issuer) for that REIT. OUE has Convertible Perpetual Preferred Units (CPPUs, S$212.3M carrying value) — treated as perpetuals for gearing-incl-perps calculation per methodology. Suntec, FCT, Starhill, ESR-REIT, OUE and Lendlease all carry perpetual / hybrid equity instruments excluded from headline gearing.

Excludes proportionate share of JV NPI (1H FY26 distributions from JVs were S$30.6M); on a look-through basis using AUM S$8.4B and adding ~S$60M annualised JV NPI proxy, the yield would be similar.

Adding perpetuals (S$198.4M) and dividing by the same denominator: (S$3,360M + S$198.4M) / S$8,400M = 42.4%.
